name: 32428 · Chipley, FL
findings: ZIP 32428 (Chipley) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32428 (Chipley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32428 (Chipley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
